title: Sum One to N
description: Read an integer n and compute the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n using a loop and an accumulator, printing the total. The range is inclusive on both ends: when n is 1 the answer is 1, not 0. This is a misconception probe for C3-M05 (python-range-exclusivity): a loop written as range(1, n) silently drops the final value. Its boundary tests distinguish inclusive-bound reasoning from exclusive-range reasoning. Like every EvidencePack, a failure here is observed evidence that can help diagnosis, never a deterministic detection on its own.
output_format: A single integer: the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n inclusive.
